sections.title: The leftover glow is a sound map

items.q: What are the CMB patches actually?
items.a: **Peaks and troughs of sound** in the 400,000-year-old gas — not a bang. ~**90 dB**, ~**50 octaves** below hearing, one cycle ~50,000 years. Gravity pulls, gas bounces. Fist-at-arm's-length = **8 million light-years**.

items.q: What happened when the universe turned transparent?
items.a: Waves **froze**. Matter collapsed into stars and galaxies. Today's ~100,000-galaxy web still shows the **same fundamental and harmonics** — sound turned to stone.

items.q: Where does Whittle say the pattern started?
items.a: **Inflation.** Subatomic quantum vibrations, hyperexpanded, become the sound, then the galaxy tapestry. The green-line spectrum fit is how we **measure** the universe.
Shift **50 octaves** (raw = noise, pitch drops). Map harmonics to piano keys → melody. Mikalson + Shaw: **10 minutes**, choir and organ. Closer: those first-era atoms are **in your brain**.
